name: CabinetOS
description: A dual-pane file manager for Windows 11 with a command palette, chord keys, an integrated terminal and sandboxed plugins. A Rust core does the work; the window only draws.

screenshot.alt: CabinetOS: the sidebar and the first of two file panes

name: WinCraft
description: The single-executable Windows 11 power suite: an instant command palette with a live inspector, window management and display control in one tiny Rust binary.

screenshot.alt: The WinCraft command palette in the Fluent glass theme

name: Telemetrix
description: A very light terminal screensaver and live system dashboard for Windows 11 and Linux. CPU, memory, disks and temperatures, plus Lua plugin cards, in about 8 MB of memory.

screenshot.alt: Telemetrix with the Matrix theme: system, market, network and weather cards over digital rain
